# E0218: package that isn't a dependency

A module imports only from its own package, the standard library and the packages that stilt.toml lists. Add the package to `[dependencies]`.

- Rule: [`packages.imports`](../../reference/04-programs.md#packages.imports)
- Reported at: the `use` declaration.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`E0218_undeclared_dependency`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0218_undeclared_dependency):

`deps/http/src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
use json

pub fn get() -> i64 { json.parse("2") }
```

`deps/http/stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "http"

[dependencies]
json = { path = "../json" }
```

`deps/json/src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
pub fn parse(s: str) -> i64 { 1 }
```

`deps/json/stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "json"
```

`src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
use http
use json

fn main() / io { print("{http.get()} {json.parse("1")}") }
```

`stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "app"

[dependencies]
http = { path = "deps/http" }
```

What `stilt check` prints for it:

```text
── PACKAGE THAT ISN'T A DEPENDENCY ──────────────────── src/main.lt:2:1  [E0218]

`json` is a dependency of `http`, not of this package: add `json = { path =
"deps/json" }` to its stilt.toml:

  2 │ use json
    │ ^^^^^^^^

A module imports only from its own package, the standard library and the
packages that stilt.toml lists. Add the package to `[dependencies]`.
```
